messages:
sam: Quick Q — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4825. We're adding a new optional query param `include_token_breakdown` on `POST /v1/generate`. If true we return prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens. Default is false. Before I merge I want to confirm backward compatibility and billing implications. Mobile/web clients should not break. Also how should cached_tokens interact with streaming? cc @maria @kevin @jen :eyes:

maria: product note — keep shape stable for existing clients. If `include_token_breakdown=false` return only the legacy `total_tokens` field exactly as today. If true, return the breakdown AND still include `total_tokens` so consumers that expect the old field keep working. That should be the compatibility rule. :+1:

kevin: technical: runtime currently calculates token counts post-generation. For KV cache hits we track `kv_hits` per request, but consumers want token counts. I propose we convert kv_hits -> token equivalents on the server and return `cached_tokens` as a number. Example response we should document: ```json
{"total_tokens":42, "prompt_tokens":30, "completion_tokens":10, "cached_tokens":2}
``` Here `cached_tokens` is any prefix served from KV or prefix cache.

jen: billing perspective — we bill only on non-cached tokens. Our billing pipeline currently uses `total_tokens` and a separate cache-log join. New schema should make invoicing simpler: set `billable_tokens = total_tokens - cached_tokens`. Important: if `cached_tokens` is missing (old responses) fallback to previous logic. We'll need an analytics migration to populate `cached_tokens` historically where possible or run a delta-check to avoid invoice jumps.

sam: streaming nuance: most clients rely on partial chunks for progress. We can't emit full breakdown on every chunk (overhead). Should we just include breakdown in the final event? Thoughts?

kevin: plan: streaming will send intermediate chunks with `delta_text` only (no token fields). The final `response_end` event will include the full breakdown object. That keeps perf and gives accurate totals. We'll document event schema: intermediate messages -> {"type":"chunk","text":"..."}; final -> {"type":"end","text":"...","total_tokens":..,"prompt_tokens":..,"completion_tokens":..,"cached_tokens":..}.

maria: sounds good. Add a note: some SDKs auto-sum token deltas for progress UIs — we should document that those sums may not match final breakdown because cached prefixes aren't emitted in chunks. Recommend using final breakdown for billing.

jen: action items for accounting: 1) update analytics ETL to compute `billable_tokens` = total - cached; 2) add a compatibility check job to compare historical totals and flag customers with >10% delta; 3) add migration docs for enterprise customers with committed usage so they can opt to keep legacy behavior for one billing cycle.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4825, staging deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T09:30Z :rocket:

sam: thanks all. @kevin can you add unit tests for the analytics join and a small integration test that simulates a cached prefix so billing calc is validated? I'll wait for +2 before merging. Also please add a short note in the breaking-changes doc even though this is additive. :eyes:

kevin: on it. I added the tests locally and pushed to the branch, linking test plan: https://go/redwood/testplan/4825. Will add a changelog entry and a short migration snippet for billing. :thumbsup:

jen: I'll prepare an internal memo for finance ops about the new `cached_tokens` field and the reconciliation rule. Also will coordinate with customer success for any flagged customers.

sam: perfect. merging after kevin's PR updates and one more review from @maria. Thanks everyone.
